sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 34 points from 16 games, face Shawbury United at home on Saturday 21 November at 15:00. The leaders come into this match in excellent recent form, having won their last league outing and recorded three wins in their last six league games. Shawbury United will provide the opposition at Edgeley Park, sitting 13th with 17 points.
divisionWide: The division's other midweek fixture sees New Mills host Crewe on Tuesday 17 November at 19:45, with both sides looking to climb the table after inconsistent recent form. AFC Bridgnorth travel to Shawbury United on the same evening, with the visitors continuing their strong campaign as third-placed contenders. On Saturday, second-placed Wolverhampton Casuals' absence from the fixtures means Sandbach could extend their lead if results favour them. Alsager Town host New Mills in a basement-area clash, while Crewe face Cheadle Heath Nomads as both battle mid-table consolidation. AFC Bridgnorth host Wednesfield Community in a match between sides separated by 14 league positions. Dawley Town welcome struggling Foley Meir in a fixture at the foot of the table, Market Drayton Town travel to in-form Stafford Town (currently 6th), and Widnes Town host Brereton Social in a battle of the lower reaches.
